verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm resolve/ignore (time, occurrence, rule-based) status workflow and an error-statuses triage inbox, but there is no explicit mention of assigning an owner to an issue, snoozing (distinct from ignore-for-time), or automatic reopening of a resolved issue upon regression. missing for 10: owner assignment feature, explicit snooze action, and documented auto-reopen-on-regression behavior.
